'''Bator''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Imperial operative who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3641 BBY]], he was stationed on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] where he tasked a fellow Imperial to retrieve the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] researchers responsible for the domination experiments from the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]] that were holding the researchers hostage.
